verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say its built-in Cloud backend includes edge functions, so you can add server-side functions from the builder. They also document generated integrations, a built-in AI connector, and a ClickHouse app connector, so third-party integrations are a first-party capability. However, no evidence shows payment or email-sending integrations specifically, and nothing describes how functions are authored or managed in depth. Missing for 10: documented payments integration (e.g. Stripe), documented transactional email integration, detailed edge-function docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add server-side functions and third-party integrations like payments and email from the builder

citations.quote: includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required
Lovable generates a working application that includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations, all backed by editable code
the ClickHouse app + chat connector lets your Lovable app run SQL queries against your ClickHouse database over the HTTP interface
Lovable's built-in AI connector handles that setup for you, so you can add AI features to your app by describing what you want to build.
